name: 6-methyltryptamine
summary: 6-Methyltryptamine (6-Me-T or 6-methyl-T; developmental code name PAL-522) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 6-methyl derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 6-Methyltryptamine (6-Me-T or 6-methyl-T; developmental code name PAL-522) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. The drug acts as a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 75.3 nM and an Emax of 110%. It is about 10-fold less potent as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist than tryptamine itself.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin–dopamine releasing agent
